records.name: Drift
records.subject: a cheerful little flame-shaped wisp spirit, two simple dark eyes, curling cyan tail
records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one Wisp application default profile-picture avatar. Create ONE finished square 1024x1024 avatar, not a sheet. A cohesive original pixel-art character portrait for a privacy-focused chat app whose branding uses pixel lettering, cyan-to-lavender accents and soft graphite backgrounds. Style: polished chunky pixel art, deliberately crisp stair-step silhouettes, large readable shapes, limited color ramps, subtle pixel highlights, restrained shading, no vector smooth curves, no photorealism, no 3D render. The subject should feel calm, friendly and distinctive rather than babyish. Center a single large subject occupying about 70 percent of the square, fully within a circle-safe central 78 percent; strong silhouette legible as a 32-pixel circular avatar. Background: opaque uniform dark soft graphite #191f25 with only a few restrained square sparkles near the subject, no border or frame. No typography, letters, logos, labels, watermark, UI, or extra characters. Avoid clutter, blurry glow, fine detail, checkerboards and collage. Subject: a cheerful little flame-shaped wisp spirit, two simple dark eyes, curling cyan tail. Accent palette: icy cyan and pale blue.
